resource: Allen Cell Types GLIF model-run metadata
limits: The Allen RMA response is not an immutable versioned dataset release. The archived timestamp/hash and exact model/run identifiers are retained.
Current API model-run IDs and EVR values match all 2,000 primary-cohort records; other returned fields are not asserted identical.
This binds model-performance metadata and cohort membership, not raw electrophysiological feature extraction, model refitting or the temporal-fit pipeline.
No raw NWB, third-party model configuration or new data license is redistributed.
